guitar.notes: Chaka Khan is a vocalist; not a guitar-led act, no iconic associated guitarist/instrument.

tone.target: fat clean funk riff with wah quack and light grit
tone.profile: fat clean funk riff with wah quack and light grit
tone.summary: A tight funk chain using a Boost/OD for attack, Wah for rhythmic accents, Compression for sustain, followed by a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) and 2x12 cab, finished with Room reverb.
corrections: keep the tone drier and funkier

rig.name: Chaka Khan - Tell Me Something Good - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight funk rhythm.
Provide tight attack and punch for syncopated funk rhythms.
Emulate the classic wah quack for rhythmic accents.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 does not have a dedicated foot switch control for Wah, but V-Wah is the best model choice.

blocks.purpose: Even out dynamics and enhance the 'fat' sustain required for funk.
Introduce light grit and harmonic richness without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: Using Red Haze at low settings to achieve 'light grit' rather than full saturation.

blocks.purpose: Provide the clean, punchy Fender-style tone required for funk.
Emulate the clean, bright sound of a small combo speaker.
Enhance the 'fat midrange' and punch of the funk riff.
Add subtle space and depth without muddying the tight funk rhythm.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better funk definition.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and midrange focus of the clean funk tone.
